detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for behaviors and indicators associated with well-known malware families (e.g., Emotet, GandCrab, Mirai, Gh0st.Rat), including command and control communications, lateral movement, and exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities.
